description: A strategy where the database holds a row for one transaction so competing transactions wait their turn.
A lock mode that produces SELECT FOR UPDATE, blocking other writers and lockers until commit.
A shared lock mode that allows other readers but blocks writers until the transaction ends.
The Spring Data annotation that applies a LockModeType to a repository query method.
A cycle where each transaction waits for a row the other holds, so the database aborts one of them.
Always locking rows in the same order, such as ascending id, so cycles cannot form.
